plot: At dawn in the kitchen Zeek's Snooze Beam meant for the sleeping jelly Wobblor hits Bup, who sleepwalks toward the sink while the others must stay silent; Zeek's Wake-Up Ray bounces off the jelly and puts everyone else to sleep, so the newly awake Bup carries his snoring friends to safety alone, and then they realize the first beam flew out the window and put the sun to sleep.

beats.say: Snooze Beam, test one! Nobody move! Especially nobody step in front of the—
Zzz... five more minutes... the pancakes are talking...
You zapped BUP! Our leader is SNORING! Who leads us now? Not me! Never me!
Dawn in the kitchen. Zeek built the Snooze Beam for Wobblor, the giant jelly napping in the sink. Instead, it hit Bup.
Mmm... snore... wobbly dreams...
And Bup is walking. Straight toward the sink. With both eyes closed.
Sleepwalking. A known side effect. It's on page forty of my notes.
You WROTE that down and you still zapped him?
Page forty is a very long page. It also has a drawing of a duck on it.
One loud sound, and the jelly wakes up hungry. Whisper. Everyone.
I can't whisper! My whisper is just a scream wearing a little hat!
Team... the plan... is pancakes... with sprinkles...
He's sleep-planning. Bup, sweetie, turn left. Left. LEFT.
Left is for quitters... zzz...
I'll reverse the beam. A Wake-Up Ray. Give me thirty seconds to rewire it.
Bup climbs the dish rack in his sleep, one perfect step at a time.
How is he better at climbing when he's ASLEEP?!
No fear when you are dreaming. Only pancakes. I remember that feeling, long ago.
Mmm... something smells like... warm bread...
The jelly is sniffing him! He thinks Bup is breakfast! Zeek, hurry up!
Done! Wake-Up Ray, full power! Aiming at Bup and...
The ray hits the jelly, bounces off like a rubber ball, and zaps everybody else.
Oh no... I feel... so... cozy...
Nighty... night... I'll be fierce... later...
Darkness... takes... me...
Wrong... polarity... zzz...
Huh?! Where am I? Why am I on a dish rack? Why is everybody asleep?!
Mmm... toasty bread... come closer... closer...
Nope. Not today, jelly. My friends carried me a hundred times. Today the loaf carries the team.
One by one, Bup tiptoes his sleeping friends off the counter. A bean. A star. A rock. A very heavy triangle.
Zeek, what do you EAT? Bricks? Textbooks?
Zzz... calculations... carry the two... no, carry the bean... the bean is heavy...
Hm? Was someone here? ...No. Just a dream.
Everybody safe. Nobody swallowed. I am the best leader in all of Table Land.
Bup! I'm awake! What happened? Did I faint? I definitely fainted.
You took a nap. A very brave nap. I carried you the whole way, and you snored like a trumpet.
Bup. The first beam. The Snooze Beam. Where did it go after it hit you?
Out the window, I think. Toward the sky. Why? Is that bad? Your face says that is bad.
Because the sun should be up by now. And outside it is still... dark.
Zeek. Did you put the SUN to sleep?

long.title: Don't Wake the Jelly! (Bup Is Sleepwalking) 😱
long.description: Zeek's Snooze Beam was meant for Wobblor, the giant jelly napping in the sink... but it hit Bup. Now the leader is sleepwalking straight toward the jelly, and nobody is allowed to make a sound. Would YOU have woken him up? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy
